notes.title: RoboDunk Prologue OUT NOW
notes.content:
Hi everyone, the [b][u]free prologue for RoboDunk[/u][/b] is available [b][u]right now[/u][/b]!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2385890/RoboDunk_Prologue/

In this brand new game mode the stadiums have been taken over by the Robot Masters,
and you're the only one who can defeat them with the power of DUNK.
You can choose to face them in any order. If you win, you steal their skills.
But be careful: the others get stronger after your every victory!
Can you beat them all?

You can play solo, full coop, or versus with up to 4 friends.

If you played the demo and liked it, or if this is your first time with RoboDunk, please [b][u]leave a nice review[/u][/b] so other people like us can discover it too.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40712776/76d6e16332ec23de576d14d8d508b311955a260d.gif[/img]

And remember... I put some [b]Fly Punch Boom secrets in it[/b]!
First person to find them all [u][b]gets a prize[/b][/u].

How hard is this Robot Masters challenge? Too easy? Too hard? Let me know.
As always, may the power of DUNK be with you.
